title: Laundry Management System
tagline: A photo-real laundry shop website with live order tracking and pickup booking — that quietly reveals the Cyberussell system behind it at the end.

liveProduct.text: This concept grew into a real product —
liveProduct.label: see the Laundry Management System live

overview: A self-initiated concept build with a twist: it's designed first as the official website of a fictional local business, "Aling Maria Laundry Shop" — real photography, live order tracking, pickup booking — and only reveals near the bottom of the page that it's a Cyberussell portfolio piece, showcasing "LaundryFlow," the management system quietly running the business behind the scenes.
problem: Most laundry and dry-cleaning businesses run on paper logs or generic point-of-sale software that wasn't built for their workflow. And most "we build software" portfolio pieces look like software demos, not like something a real customer would actually want to visit and book from — which makes it harder for a prospective client to picture their own business looking this good.
solution: Built around a bold black-and-yellow brand system with real photography of attendants at work, a trust strip, and a services grid — then a live-look order-tracking demo: a mock browser window that walks a customer's wash from Received through Washing, Drying, and Folding to Ready for Pickup. A dedicated 3-step pickup-booking flow (Contact → Service → Details → Confirmed) lets a visitor actually schedule a pickup. Further down the page, a pricing-tiers section reveals the real LaundryFlow SaaS system running behind the scenes and invites laundry-business owners to request their own site.
results: A live concept demo that sells two things at once — a laundry shop website that actually looks worth switching to, and the SaaS-grade order-tracking system behind it — with real photography and a live tracking mockup that make the pitch tangible rather than another generic case study.
